text: This report seeks approval to amend the Fire Route By-law to designate certain locations as fire routes within the meaning of City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 880, as amended. It was previously considered by the North York Community Council at its meeting on February 21, 2018. On March 2, 2018, City Council's delegation of fire route designations to Community Councils came into effect. City Council no longer has jurisdiction to deal with this matter. Community Councils now have final decision making authority for fire route designations. As a result, this report is resubmitted to Community Council for further consideration and final decision under the delegated authority in Subsection 27-152 F(1) of Chapter 27, Council Procedures.

North York Community Council: 1. Designated part or those parts of the private road or roads shown on the site plan filed with the Fire Chief in respect of the municipal addresses set out below, as fire routes pursuant to Municipal Code Chapter 880 - Fire Routes: a. 80 Scarsdale Road; and b. 1325 Lawrence Avenue East. 2. Authorized the Fire Chief and City Solicitor to take the appropriate action to make a designated Fire Route.
